subject: general
question: The refractive index of fluid A is 1.47. This means ____________.

options.text: the speed of light in fluid A is 1.47 times greater than the speed of light in air.
the speed of light in fluid A is increased 1.47 times than the speed of light in water
the speed of light in fluid A is 1.47 times greater than the speed of light in water.
the speed of light in fluid A is reduced by 1.47 times than the speed of light in vacuum

solution:
The correct answer is **__the speed of light in fluid A is reduced by 1.47 times than the speed of light in vacuum.__ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A medium's refractive index (n) is defined as the** ratio of the speed of light in a vacuum to the speed of light in air. **
 
• Mathematically, it is n={cover v}where **c is the speed of light in a vacuum and v is the speed of light in air.**
 
• The refractive index is the relationship between the speed of light and the speed at which light travels.
 
• For example, **the refractive index of glass** is about **1.5, meaning** that **light is 1.5 slower** in that medium.
 
• So, here the refractive index of fluid A is 1.47 which means that the **speed of light in fluid A is reduced by 1.47 times** that of the speed of light in a vacuum.
